title: Fine-Tuning and Alignment
summary: Turning a base model into a useful one, concept first, then hands-on on a laptop CPU, free Colab or a rented GPU: instruction tuning, LoRA and QLoRA, preference tuning (RLHF, DPO, KTO, ORPO, SimPO), GRPO with verifiable rewards, and fine-tuning embedding models.
